notes: Lithuania 2026-11-05, INCOMPLETE run. Tooling limit: WebFetch only opened URLs returned by search, so no clinic's own website could be opened (sites named in directory pages, e.g. 8drambliai.lt, mambaveterinaras.lt, vetmed.lt, bravoveta.lt, vetpagalba.lt, bvkklinika.lt, vmvt.lt, lsmuni.lt, were refused as not-in-provenance; lrvalstybe.lt/kontaktai/administracija-872 failed). Only aggregator pages (1551.lt, petla.app) described the following clinics, so they were NOT published per runbook: '8 drambliai' hospital Vilnius (Nemenčinės pl. 4C / Tolimoji g. 2B, +370 612 88788, hours 08-24, 1551 title says 'visą parą' but its own fields conflict) and Antakalnis/Pilaitė branches; '8 drambliai' referentinė veterinarijos ligoninė Klaipėda (Liepų g. 73; 1551 title 'visą parą veikianti'); MB Mambavet Klaipėda (Paryžiaus Komunos g. 2, +370 671 02331, 1551 says 'budinti visą parą' but lists Mon-Fri 9-18); Jakovo veterinarijos centras Vilnius (vetmed.lt); Bravoveta Šilutė; Naujosios Vilnios veterinarijos gydykla; Buivydiškių klinika; Vetfauna; Zookomfort; Gedmino vet Šiauliai. These are strong 24 h candidates to verify on their own sites next run (8drambliai.lt, mambaveterinaras.lt). No national duty rota found (VMVT/LVGA pages checked via register entry contain none). No animal poison line found (searches returned only human toxicology/foreign services). Lietuvos veterinarijos gydytojų asociacija contact: K. Donelaičio g. 2 Kaunas, +370 695 34879 (not a clinic, not added). Not covered: Vilnius, Klaipėda, Šiauliai, Panevėžys, Alytus, Palanga, Birštonas, Nida clinics (no own-source page opened).
